desc: Parse N and X, and group the N foods into three lists according to vitamin type V_i.
For each vitamin type, run a 0/1 knapsack DP over calories 0..X to compute best_v[c] = maximum vitamin amount obtainable with total calories at most c (arrays nondecreasing).
Implement feasibility check for threshold t: for each vitamin find smallest c with best_v[c] >= t (bisect over monotone array); feasible iff sum of the three costs <= X.
Binary search the maximum feasible t in [0, min(best_1[X], best_2[X], best_3[X])], treating t = 0 as always feasible.
Ideation: choose algorithm (independent per-vitamin knapsacks + binary search on the answer).
Output the resulting maximum t; verified against both public samples (both PASSED) and edge cases (empty vitamin group, large A_i).
Verified the cheap-vitamin DP truncation + extension logic keeps best_v monotone and correct through capacity X.
